subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the remaining Talk/Voice selector ship Android-first using existing gateway agent/session state, or wait for a shared companion-app Talk UX across Android, iOS, and macOS?
rationale: Current main already settled the canonical TTS config path, but the session-routing UX and app scope are still product choices rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Ship Android-first selector
options.body: Add an Android Voice/Talk agent/session selector now using the existing gateway agent list and session-key routing, then align other companion apps later.

options.title: Design shared companion UX
options.body: Pause implementation until Android, iOS, and macOS agree on a common Talk/Voice target-selection model.

options.title: Defer behind Chat selector
options.body: Wait for #80422 or a replacement Chat selector to land before wiring Voice/Talk to the same selection state.

recommendation.title: Ship Android-first selector
recommendation.body: Add an Android Voice/Talk agent/session selector now using the existing gateway agent list and session-key routing, then align other companion apps later.

likelyOwner.reason: He already scoped the implemented-vs-remaining split on this issue and owns the TTS side of the decision trail.
